title: Dhurandhar - Reality of Propaganda?
description:
People are calling Dhurandhar fake, propaganda, and over-the-top. Critics say it promotes hyper-nationalism and toxic masculinity. The film is banned in some countries, yet it’s breaking box office records and going massively viral. So the real question is: if it’s all fake, why is it working?

In this video, we go beyond opinions and look at facts. Character by character, event by event, we break down what is real and what is cinematic storytelling. From gang wars in Karachi to 26/11 handlers, fake currency networks, IC 814 hijacking, and the pattern of “unknown gunmen” in Pakistan — much of what the film shows is already documented in news reports, investigations, and global records.

At the same time, we also examine the other side. The timeline has been reshaped, events have been stitched together for impact, and there is a clear political narrative being pushed. Like every film, this too reflects the creator’s perspective.
So is Dhurandhar propaganda, or is it a dramatized version of real events? The truth lies somewhere in between.

Watch till the end and decide for yourself.
